name: Tekken3Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of the PlayStation version of Tekken 3 into a native application for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. The hub builds it from your own Tekken 3 USA disc (first build takes several minutes and needs 4 GB free); Jun Kazama is added when both arcade sets are configured. Its launcher manages mods, controllers and memory cards.

labels.hint: Your own Tekken 3 USA (SLUS-00402) disc image

howToPlay.title: Choose your Tekken 3 disc
howToPlay.detail: Under Your game files, select your Tekken 3 USA disc image (SLUS-00402). Add both arcade sets too if you want Jun Kazama.

howToPlay.title: Click Install
howToPlay.detail: The game is built from your disc. The first build takes several minutes and needs about 4 GB free.

howToPlay.title: Click Play
howToPlay.detail: The game's launcher opens. Set up controllers, memory cards and mods there, then start the game.

sources.purpose: The game is recompiled from this disc
